t: Buying Vineyard Land - WineMakerMag.com
s: Most home winemaking vineyards are an acre or less, and most commercial vineyards are 5 acres or more. If you’re not sure which way you want to go, my usual recommendation is to start with an acre. An acre of vines can be farmed by a single devoted individual, and will produce enough crop in its third or fourth year to give you an excellent indication of wine quality from that locale. If you are going commercial make sure you have a potential audience for your wines, or winemakers that have agreed to buy the fruit before you plant.
